Project cards — bigger art, aligned counts, and where "Review" lives

All three variants share the two things you asked for: the poster grows from 44×58 to 60×80 so it fills the card, and the "20 of 20 left" counts are pinned to the right edge — the same spot on every card no matter how many dashes a project has. The variants differ only in what sits in the top-right corner.

Variant A — nothing at rest — buttons appear on hover

Your instinct, taken all the way: the static REVIEW pill is gone. The right-aligned count already tells you what needs doing (“20 of 20 left” = needs review, “4 to schedule”, “all scheduled”). Put your mouse on the card and the real Review button and the delete bin appear together in the top-right — so delete no longer fights for the right edge.
